caption:
Snap windows side by side on Windows. ⌨️

Win + Left Arrow = left half
Win + Right Arrow = right half
Win + Up Arrow = maximize

Follow @techmendly for a new tech tip every day.

#windows #windows11 #windows10 #shortcuts #productivity #keyboardshortcuts #multitasking #techtips #pctips #techmendly

scenes.text: Stop dragging windows around to fit them.
scenes.say: Stop dragging windows around to fit them. Use two keys instead.

scenes.title: Snap to the left half
scenes.body: The active window fills the left side.
scenes.say: Hold the Windows key and press the left arrow. Your window fills the left half.

scenes.title: Snap to the right half
scenes.body: Now pick another window for the other side.
scenes.say: Windows key and right arrow puts it on the right half. Then pick another window for the other side.

scenes.title: Fill the whole screen
scenes.body: Win + Down Arrow shrinks it again.
scenes.say: Windows key and up arrow makes a window fill the screen. Down arrow brings it back.
Dragging is slow and fiddly. The shortcut takes two keys.

scenes.sub: A new tech tip every day
scenes.say: Save this shortcut for later. Follow TechMendly for a new tech tip every day.
